# Ultimate Thumbnail Maker

> Ultimate Thumbnail Maker is a dedicated Android graphic design application for content creators, vloggers, and gaming streamers to design high-CTR YouTube video covers, channel art, and banners directly on mobile devices.

## Application Overview

- [Official Website](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/): The official product homepage with feature highlights, preview gallery, and Android app download links.
- [Google Play Store Listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sk.thumbnailmaker): Official distribution on Google Play (Package: com.sk.thumbnailmaker, 5,000,000+ installs, Art & Design).
- [About Developer & Project](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/about/): Background information on developer Nilesh Jain, editorial mission, and app verification.

## Creator Guides & Features

- [YouTube Thumbnail Maker Guide](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/youtube-thumbnail-maker/): Comprehensive guide to 16:9 YouTube video thumbnail composition, bold mobile typography, and contrast rules.
- [Gaming Thumbnail Maker](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/gaming-thumbnail-maker/): Workflows for game streaming covers, action highlights, RGB glow effects, and streamer facecam placement.
- [Background Removal & Cutout Tool](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/thumbnail-maker-with-background-removal/): Built-in subject isolation and background removal to extract creator portraits and game characters without Photoshop.
- [10-Step YouTube Thumbnail Tutorial](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/how-to-make-a-youtube-thumbnail/): Practical step-by-step masterclass covering canvas sizing, template selection, text hierarchy, color grading, and YouTube Studio export.

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/privacy-policy/): Complete data governance disclosure confirming 100% on-device local photo editing, camera/storage permissions, and Google AdMob ad compliance.
- [Authorized Digital Sellers (app-ads.txt)](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/app-ads.txt): Official IAB app-ads.txt verification for Google AdMob publisher pub-5679281465772614.
- [Contact & Support](https://ultimatethumbnailmaker.pages.dev/contact/): Developer inquiry channel, feedback form, and technical support guidelines.
